channel.title: Libya - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Libya, every source cited.

item.title: Libyan MP warns of danger to poor children's education
item.description: Jayallah Al-Shaibani says suspending classes denies poor children access to schooling while wealthy families find alternatives.

item.title: Libya parliament to debate unified public sector pay scale
item.description: Teachers demand action as lawmakers review salary legislation that has exposed divisions among public employees.

item.title: Libya economy minister meets farmers on production challenges
item.description: Tripoli meeting addressed rising input costs, feed shortages, and market price stability for local produce.

item.title: Libya launches engineering project management conference in Tripoli
item.description: The two-day event focuses on sustainable development and reconstruction in key sectors.

item.title: Tripoli Chamber signs economic deal with Italian counterpart
item.description: An agreement aims to boost trade, joint ventures, and investment between Libya and Italy.
